requirements.text: A model identification questionnaire is submitted to MRM before development or acquisition of a quantitative method whose output is used for decisions, risk measurement, valuation or reporting.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: MRM determines within 20 business days whether the tool is a model, records the rationale, and enters non-models in the tools register.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the MRM function in the model identification process; evidenced in MRM identification records and the tools register, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: Business line heads attest annually that all models and tools are registered, and MRM performs an annual identification sweep including end-user computing and third-party services.
requirements.level_reason: Institution-wide attestation and identification process; evidenced in business line attestations and the MRM sweep report, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: A model found in use without registration is registered immediately, reported to the MRC and assigned a provisional tier at least one tier higher than assessed until validated.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The model has a unique model identifier assigned at registration (gate G0) and each model version has a version number in the inventory.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The inventory record states the model name, version, purpose, intended and secondary uses, scope of application, risk type, regulatory use and model family.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The inventory record names the model owner, model developer, main model users and the assigned validation team.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The inventory record states the model tier with the materiality and complexity scores, the tier rationale and the date of the last tier review.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The inventory record states the lifecycle stage and gate status, the latest validation opinion and date, the next validation date, open findings by severity, open conditions, limitations and post-model adjustments.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The inventory record states the AI Act classification, whether personal data is processed and the DPIA reference.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The inventory record states the supervisory permission status and open supervisory findings and obligations for the model.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The model owner updates the inventory record within ten business days of any change to a mandatory attribute and at each lifecycle gate.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The model owner attests the completeness and accuracy of the inventory record quarterly.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: All mandatory inventory attributes are complete for Tier 1 and Tier 2 models.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The tier is proposed by the model owner using the tiering template, approved by MRM and confirmed at the first validation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: Materiality is scored High, Medium or Low on exposure, own funds impact, income statement or provision impact, customer impact and regulatory impact, with the highest criterion score applied.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: Complexity is scored on methodology, inputs, data limitations, expert judgement, dependencies, output uncertainty and vendor transparency; ML and GenAI models score at least Medium.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The tier is derived from the materiality-by-complexity matrix of §6.4.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: A model used for own funds requirements, financial reporting, ICAAP or stress testing, IRRBB measurement or AML/CFT obligations is at least Tier 2.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The assigned tier is not lower than the matrix outcome; a higher tier assigned by MRM is supported by a documented rationale.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The tier is reviewed at least annually and at every material change; downgrading a Tier 1 model requires MRC approval.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The model is validated periodically at least annually for Tier 1, every two years for Tier 2 and every three years for Tier 3, counted from the previous validation opinion.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: Irrespective of tier, the model used for own funds requirements under the IRB approach or the market risk internal model approach is validated at least annually.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to internal models requiring supervisory permission (IRB rating systems and market risk IMA) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal provision. Annual validation of IRB models is consistent with CRR Art. 185 and the ECB guide to internal models (general topics); the exact external basis for IMA models should be confirmed.

requirements.text: A full-scope validation is performed at initial validation, after every material change and at least every three years for Tier 1 models.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The model has exactly one model owner, a 1LoD senior manager recorded in the inventory, who remains accountable when tasks are delegated.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: A change of model owner is recorded within ten business days with a signed handover note listing open findings, conditions, limitations and dispensations.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: A model without an owner for more than 30 days is reported to the MRC, which designates an interim owner.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of MRM and the Model Risk Committee; evidenced in MRC minutes, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.
